depicted_variant: Wujud alamiah bermuka rakun dan tubuh badger dengan ghost-fire tanuki-bi, close-up agung namun tidak jahat.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala bermuka rakun, tubuh badger Jepang, empat kaki dan ekor tanpa fitur faceless.
Menciptakan ghost-fire mirip will-o'-the-wisps, api kecil terpisah yang memantul pada tanah.
Latar tanah gelap editorial, tidak diklaim lokasi cerita.

aura: Wujud hibrida mujina-c02 dan api ghost-fire mujina-c04 memberi keagungan ganjil dengan hati lembut mujina-c15.
artistic_choices: Palet cokelat gelap, cahaya api dan close-up tanah editorial; tidak diberi ukuran raksasa.
Tidak menggabungkan varian biksu/belly-drum; tanuki-bi berupa api terpisah, bukan aura.
Ekspresi waspada menggetarkan namun tidak membuat trickster berhati lembut menjadi pemangsa.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MUJINA, the shapeshifting Japanese yokai in its natural hybrid form.
ANATOMY: ONE RACCOON-FACED head, masked dark eyes, TWO eyes, JAPANESE BADGER body with FOUR paws and ONE short badger tail; dense coarse brown fur. NOT a raccoon body, NOT a faceless human, no oversized belly. [mujina-c02]
MOMENT: stepping boldly from black shadow toward the viewer, one paw thrust into foreground, head leaning downward with an intensely watchful wise gaze, fur and dry leaves swept by motion.
POWER: creates tanuki-bi GHOST FIRE like will-o'-the-wisps; THREE small distinct amber flames just above the ground behind and beside it, illuminating leaves physically, not surrounding the body. [mujina-c04]
SCALE & CAMERA: ground-level close macro framing, ordinary badger size, face and paw dominate, no giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: the separated ghost flames are one dominant amber light source, deep walnut darkness, ordinary dust.
SURFACE: matted coarse fur, moist nose, gritty earth and dead leaves.
SETTING: neutral dark ground, editorial background, no invented narrative location.
MOOD: overwhelming uncanny dignity, intense but not evil, respecting its gentle heart; never cute/calm/decorative. [mujina-c15]
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, exposed breasts or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.
reason: Natural-form face too soft and cute, reads as ordinary raccoon despite ghostfire; Uji Sangar item2/7 gagal.
